title: Measurement
description: Automatically recorded series of measurements - implant remote monitoring (e.g. a pacemaker's battery level) or imaging equipment QA (e.g. a phantom scan's dose or image-quality readings). Has to be submitted with entry type sensor_reading and to come from a device key. The value of these entries lies in their being able to contradict a human self-declaration (OWM-9, oracle problem).

key.description: Key identifier of the device. A sensor's trust level is capped by that of its operator.

unit.description: Unit per UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20, e.g. P1 for percent, CEL for degrees Celsius.
